brief.concept: How to Compare Player Prop Odds Quickly: A Desktop Research Workflow
brief.primary_question: How can someone compare the same player prop across multiple platforms without confusing the line, price, payout terms, or research signal?
brief.audience: A desktop-first DFS, pick'em, or sportsbook researcher who wants a repeatable comparison process in plain language.
brief.learning_outcome: Viewers can build a manual comparison ledger, match the exact player/stat/direction/line, record source and timestamp, separate price from payout context, add Propeller signal and evidence, and accept no action when the rows do not match or the evidence is stale.
brief.cta: Open the current Propeller Analyzer at https://propellerpicks.com/analyzer/ and use the companion workflow at https://propellerpicks.com/guides/compare-player-prop-lines/.
brief.freshness_requirements: Use fresh desktop and mobile captures of the public Analyzer and a current payout-calculator surface. Any line-comparison numbers must be visibly illustrative. Verify the exact line, timestamp, platform terms, player and event status before any conclusion.
